message_en: Tomato at Kolar mandi is Rs 2,300 per quintal (25 Nov), higher than the recent average.
message_local: ಕೋಲಾರ ಮಂಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಟೊಮೇಟೊ ಕ್ವಿಂಟಾಲ್‌ಗೆ ₹2,300 (25 ನವೆಂಬರ್), ಇತ್ತೀಚಿನ ಸರಾಸರಿಗಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು.
reasons: On 2026-11-25 the modal price at Kolar was Rs 2300 per quintal, 15.0% above the average of Rs 2000 over the previous 5 reported days.
This may be a reasonable time to sell, but prices can change from day to day.
assumptions: Comparison is with the recent average only; this is not a price forecast.
